question: What power to shake the triple world arises from contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: The practitioner is instructed to contemplate a smoke-colored form.
This contemplation is to be done continually.
Such contemplation grants power over the triple world.
inference: By continually contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
